one_liner: AI-assisted civic letters are built, but investibility waits on paid conversion and deliverability.
directive: Upgrade the project soul for VC-grade scrutiny while preserving repo evidence and tagging every external or forward-looking claim as an assumption.

authority.adoption: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12 [evidence: dispatch brief]; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read existing planning files and master plan
Inspected current app structure for real implementation evidence
Compared stale planning state against current code
Built bottom-up market and financial model using implemented pricing tiers
Labeled all external and forward-looking claims as assumptions

planningMethod.honestyLabels: repo files cited as evidence; network-unverified market claims tagged as assumptions

customer.icp: US resident with a specific civic issue who wants researched, cited, correctly routed official correspondence but will not complete the workflow manually.

tam.campaignsPerYear: 20,000,000 [assumption: directional civic-intent population, unverified without network]

sam.campaignsPerYear: 4,000,000 [assumption: 20% of TAM, constrained by official coverage and trust]

market.marketCaveat: Market sizing is a workspace-only planning model, not externally validated research.

revenueStreams: Priority complex review [assumption: in master plan, not current proof]
Future API access [assumption: deferred roadmap concept]

unitEconomics.blendedAsp: $15 [assumption: midpoint tier used as base case]

revenueAssumptions: Base Year volume is 600 paid submissions [assumption: 50 per month]
Growth Year volume is 4,800 paid submissions [evidence: .planning/existing-state.md]
costAssumptions: AI plus delivery cost is $0.75 per submission [evidence: .planning/GENESIS.md]
Base infrastructure and tooling is $1,590 per year [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Review, ops, compliance, and support remain fractional until validation [assumption: lean operator plan]
sensitivityTests: If ASP falls to $5, Base Year revenue is $3,000 [assumption: 600 times $5]
If AI plus delivery rises to $2.00, gross margin at $15 ASP becomes 81.5% [assumption: adverse token and delivery case]
If annual volume is only 120 submissions, annual revenue is $1,800 [assumption: 120 times $15]

baseCase.listedCosts: $7,981 [assumption: payment fees plus variable cost plus infra plus ops plus compliance]

alternatives.name: Manual email to officials
alternatives.position: Free substitute; CivicState must beat it through convenience, routing, citations, and tracking.

alternatives.name: Resistbot
alternatives.position: Fast civic contact substitute; CivicState differentiates on citation-backed research and paid workflow.

alternatives.name: Change.org
alternatives.position: Public petition substitute; CivicState focuses on official-targeted correspondence.

alternatives.name: LegalZoom
alternatives.position: Formal document substitute; CivicState avoids legal advice and narrows to constituent communications.

alternatives.name: Quorum/VoterVoice/Phone2Action
alternatives.position: Enterprise advocacy incumbents; CivicState targets individual transactions.

holes.hole: Users may not pay for a civic workflow even if they complain about the problem.
holes.mitigation: Run paid beta before new scope; use 3% conversion gate [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].
holes.residualRisk: High until real paid conversion exists.

holes.hole: Government email deliverability may fail at official domains.
holes.mitigation: Use domain warming, Postmark tracking, and bounce-rate gates [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/delivery.ts].
holes.residualRisk: High until pilot proves 85% inbox placement [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md].

holes.hole: Citation-backed drafting may create legal-adjacent trust and liability risk.
holes.mitigation: Use citation verification, moderation, human review, AI disclosure, and not-legal-advice terms [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts; evidence: apps/web/app/terms/page.tsx].
holes.residualRisk: Medium to high because bad outputs can create complaints.

holes.hole: Registry says this is not near-term investible BOS.
holes.mitigation: Keep status draft and require operator ruling.
holes.residualRisk: Medium until operator confirms business posture.

strategy.nearTerm: Measure paid conversion, deliverability, official coverage, and review load before expanding product scope.
strategy.platformPosture: WrkPlug client posture is assumed, not hard-wired; current code uses Clerk and Stripe.

goToMarket.noPaidAcquisitionUntil: 3% conversion, 85% deliverability, and coverage gates are measured [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]

operatorWorkflow.routine: Review flagged submissions, monitor treasury, inspect delivery failures, maintain officials directory.

constraints: Watchlist personal/research asset until operator confirms business posture [evidence: dispatch registry notes]
Workspace-only run; no external market research performed [evidence: dispatch brief]
No legal conclusions invented; legal-adjacent risk kept as risk [evidence: apps/web/app/terms/page.tsx]
Current code uses Clerk and Stripe, while WrkPlug posture remains assumption-gated [evidence: apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts; evidence: apps/api/src/routes/payments.ts]

aiWorkGovernance.disclosure: AI disclosure is present in privacy and letter workflow requirements [evidence: apps/web/app/privacy/page.tsx; evidence: .planning/REQUIREMENTS.md]
aiWorkGovernance.citationPolicy: Researcher may only cite supplied sources and strips unverified citations [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/researcher.ts]
aiWorkGovernance.moderation: Threats and risky content are blocked or flagged before processing [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts]
aiWorkGovernance.humanReview: Flagged content routes to admin review [evidence: apps/api/src/routes/admin.ts]

unknowns: Whether real users pay at or above the 3% gate [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Whether official-domain deliverability clears the 85% gate [evidence: .planning/PROJECT.md]
Whether WrkPlug migration should supersede current Clerk/Stripe implementation [assumption: operator decision needed]
Whether this should remain a personal/research asset [evidence: dispatch registry notes]
